messages:
zoe_dx: Noticed a handful of new signups hit a breaking error when using our JS quickstart on Edge. Repro attached, seems tied to the new package `exports` layout we shipped yesterday. Anyone seen this pattern? :confused:

rahul_pkg: Can you paste the error?

zoe_dx: Edge console: `TypeError: RedwoodClient is not a constructor`
Quickstart import is:```js
import RedwoodClient from 'redwood-sdk';
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
```
TS shows: `TS1192: Module "redwood-sdk" has no default export.`

mike_support: Users report workaround to `import * as Redwood from 'redwood-sdk'` or `import { createClient } from 'redwood-sdk'` pointing to named exports. But that breaks the nice default-construct pattern in the docs.

rahul_pkg: I pushed an export-map simplification yesterday to handle some legacy tooling. I think I accidentally set the package `exports` so `default`/`require` point to `./dist/cjs/index.js` and omitted an explicit `import` -> `./dist/esm/index.mjs`. Edge resolvers prefer the import path and get CJS, hence interop fails.

emma_types: Also noticed types disappeared when installed via `npm pack` - our `types` entry wasn't covered by the `exports` mapping so TS consumers fell back. That explains the TS lint errors in samples.

ci-bot: Canary build report: sample-quickstart (edge) — 6/6 failed with same runtime. CI link: https://ci/internal/9012

zoe_dx: This is bad for first-run experience. People try the quickstart and hit this immediately. Can we patch fast?

rahul_pkg: Proposed fix: publish 2.6.3 with ESM-first `exports` block: "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js", "types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts", "edge": "./dist/esm/index.mjs". I'll open PR to revert the change and add the types conditional.

emma_types: +1 to adding a packaging smoke test: `npm pack` -> install tarball into a minimal `type:module` app -> run `node --experimental-modules ./index.mjs` + `tsc --noEmit`. That would catch both runtime and types regressions.

mike_support: I'll hold off updating docs until the patch is live. Also will flag open support tickets as blocked->fix and ping customers when patch drops.

rahul_pkg: Opening PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/4399 (revert export tweak + add tests). Will add a lint rule that requires `import` mapping whenever `require` or `node` are added.

zoe_dx: Thanks. If we can get a canary published I can test the sample deploy to Vercel Edge quickly. Please @ci-bot run packaging smoke tests in pre-release.

ci-bot: Scheduling packaging smoke test job on the PR.

rahul_pkg: Target: revert in next 20m, publish 2.6.3 canary within the hour if CI green.

zoe_dx: Great. I'll update the quickstart note with a temporary callout to pin to 2.6.2 until the patch is published.
